title: Admission policy debugger and synthetic SLI replay harness
creator: Aisha Raman
description:
Background: We have recurring hard-to-reproduce incidents where cross-region spikes cause the admission controller to flip circuit states and trigger unexpected load-shedding policies. Existing dashboards surface p99 token latency and circuit counts, but operators cannot deterministically replay the exact stream of admission decisions that caused a cascade.

Goal: Build a combined admission-policy debugger and synthetic SLI replay harness that can: (1) synthesize realistic request streams (tokens, sequence lengths, priority tiers, KV-hit flags) and inject them into our telemetry pipeline, (2) replay recorded traces deterministically through the admission/circuit logic in a sandboxed runtime, and (3) provide a Console-facing interactive debugger and dashboard panels that show per-request policy evaluation, circuit transitions, and token-level SLI attribution.

Scope: This ticket covers the instrumentation and dashboard buildout, plus a lightweight harness for deterministic replay. It does NOT include production rollout of the debugger UI behind customer-facing controls (separate EPIC).

Deliverables: 
- Telemetry schema additions: admission.evaluation_id, admission.steps (list as stringified events), admission.score, circuit.state_transition, synthetic_source (boolean).
- Synthetic traffic generator (go binary + k8s job) with presets: multi-region-spike, KV-miss-burst, priority-mix, cold-start-surge.
- Replay harness that can run a sequence of synthetic events through the admission microservice logic in a sandbox (local Docker task + CI job).
- New Console dashboard panels: "Admission Replay Timeline", "Per-request SLI Attribution (token-level)", "Circuit Transition Explorer".
- Playbook additions for runbook and post-incident reproducibility.

Risks & trade-offs: The replay harness must be deterministic; to achieve this we will lock RNG seeds and mock external counters (quota, available GPUs). This increases maintenance surface for the harness but is limited to the debug environment. Instrumentation fields are lightweight (mostly tags and small counters) to avoid telemetry cost bloat.

Acceptance criteria: See acceptance_criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: Can generate synthetic trace preset 'multi-region-spike' and inject into staging telemetry with a single command
Replay harness reproduces a previously recorded incident trace with >95% parity in admission decisions (same policy outcomes and circuit transitions)
Dashboard panels render admission.step events and expose per-token latency attribution within Console for a replayed trace
Runbook contains step-by-step reproduction instructions and links to the CI replay job
Telemetry schema changes validated in staging and do not increase cardinality by more than 2 tags per event
updates: 2026-03-10: Triage completed. Scope refined to instrumentation + replay harness + dashboard. Assigned to Diego.
2026-03-11: Design sync with platform and console teams. Decided to emit admission.steps as newline-delimited strings to avoid schema explosion; console parser will expand for UI only.
2026-03-12: Prototype synthetic generator v0 submitted: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/6890. Uses fixed RNG seed; includes 'multi-region-spike' and 'kv-miss-burst' presets.
2026-03-13: Replay harness prototype reproduced a 2026-02-26 incident trace in local env. Parity 93% (mismatches due to quota meter timing). Created follow-up to mock quota meter: ENG-444322.

2026-03-14: Dashboard wireframes uploaded to Confluence and Console ticket opened for embedding panels: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/RE/Admission+Replay+Debugger. Awaiting Console API review.
playbook_snippets: To run multi-region spike in staging: ./tools/synthetic-gen --preset multi-region-spike --seed 20260310 --target staging
Quick check for circuit flips: kql: events | where name=="circuit.state_transition" | sort by timestamp desc | limit 50
design_decisions: Emit admission.steps as a compact NDJSON string per request to avoid new high-cardinality fields in main telemetry stream.
Replay harness will import admission policy code as a library (same logic as production) but run in 'read-only' mode to prevent side effects.
Use fixed seeds and mocked quota/slot meters to achieve determinism for replayed traces.
Expose replay artifacts and parsed step events only in staging and sandbox namespaces; Console UI will require 'debugger' RBAC to view.
blockers: Console API for embedding timeline panels needs a small hook (Console-5908) - waiting on Console team's bandwidth.
Telemetry ingestion pipeline must accept the new synthetic_source tag without inflating cardinality - coordination with telemetry infra required (PR queued).
notes: Prototype achieved parity issues mainly from quota meter timing; follow-up ticket created to add deterministic quota mocks (ENG-444322).
Incident-2026-02-26 trace used as canonical sample for parity testing. Stored in artifacts bucket: gs://redwood-debug/replays/incident-20260226.json
We should add a lightweight recorder in the admission service to capture 'pre-eval' inputs; low-overhead sampling at 0.1% is proposed.
Plan to onboard on-call SREs in a demo session week of 2026-03-21 to validate runbook and playback flow.
